name: the #general channel with the emoji / GIF / sticker picker open

regions_read.verdict_on_region: names the channel the user is in ('# general' in the top bar, with the '#' channel sign) — a place name, counted

names the server, but as the opening greeting of the channel's message history, not as a screen title; it sits in the scrolling message stream and moves up and away as soon as messages exist (seen live) — content, not counted as an identifier

Emoji / GIFs / Stickers tab row of the expression picker; the current tab is drawn with a grey fill (declared: 'Emoji') and the fill followed each tab tapped live — locates within the picker only, counted as a sub-location

initial_rationale: top bar '# general' names the channel and stays visible (dimmed where a sheet covers the lower screen); picker/sheet headings name the panel

test_cases.precondition: app open on #general with the expression picker open
test_cases.action: tap Emoji, then Stickers, then GIFs; drag the picker to full height and scroll the GIF grid well past one screen
test_cases.expected_result: the tab highlight follows each tap, and '# general' stays visible above the picker
test_cases.confirms_if: the highlight does not move, or the channel name is covered with nothing else naming the place
test_cases.overturns_if: highlight moves with each tap and the channel name stays visible
test_cases.observed_result: the grey fill moved Emoji -> Stickers -> GIFs with each tap; at full height the top bar '# general' stayed visible, dimmed, above the sheet, and the tab row stayed pinned while the GIF grid scrolled two screens

deciding_evidence: tested live: the grey fill moved Emoji -> Stickers -> GIFs with each tap; at full height the top bar '# general' stayed visible, dimmed, above the sheet, and the tab row stayed pinned while the GIF grid scrolled two screens
